items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Vic's Beiderback, the time that he taught me in the middle of the and he taught me in a mist. I can't forget that. That was a lesson that was really a great lesson.

ctx.x: Vic was a kind of a legitimate guy?

Yeah, Vic was a strict technician. I mean, he did things that I just couldn't believe that could be possible. I remember one day I brought him a copy of Rhapsody in Blue, and it had just come out then. And Vic had never seen that tune. This was just an example of his musicianship. I've been trying to play the doing thing for over 30 years now, and I still haven't played the whole thing through. And I'm telling you, he stood there, he sat down with that copy, the original copy. I mean, nothing left out, and played…
